title: Fallen Leaves
notes: Yellow leaves blanket the floor of a grove in Olympic Forest Park, and one slender weed still stands up green among them.
lens: Tamron 25-200mm F/2.8-5.6 Di III VXD G2
alt: A low view across ground covered in fallen yellow leaves, with a single thin weed stalk standing in sharp focus in the middle and tree trunks and green woods blurred behind.
